name: 车灯光型照度法规计算

map.输入灯泡功率、光通量、照射距离与光束角度，计算中心照度并对照 GB 4599 法: Enter bulb power, luminous flux, illumination distance and beam angle to compute center illuminance and judge compliance against GB 4599.
map.前雾灯（参考中心照度 ≥ 10 lx @10m）: Front fog lamp (reference center illuminance ≥ 10 lx @10m)
map.非对称光型（近光，明暗截止线以下）: Asymmetrical pattern (low beam, below the cutoff line)
map.成本低、雨雾穿透好: Low cost, good rain and fog penetration
map.需配透镜，启动有延迟: Needs a projector lens, slow to strike
map.点光源照度 E = I ÷ d²（I 为光强 cd，d 为距离 m）。距离加倍照: Point-source illuminance E = I ÷ d² (I is intensity in cd, d the distance in m). Doubling distance cuts illuminance to 1/4, so high-beam readings are naturally low and need higher intensity to compensate; in fog also avoid the scattered glare of high color temperatures.
map.GB 4599《汽车用 LED 前照灯》与 GB 25991 等标准对近光明暗截: GB 4599 "LED headlamps for motor vehicles" and GB 25991 set minimum and maximum illuminance for the low-beam cutoff and for test points such as 75R, 50R, 50L and 25L/R. This tool judges quickly from center illuminance; the official verdict must follow the standard's own test points and a test-house report.
map.💡 改装大灯须同步校核光型与眩光：只换灯泡不调光心，往往近光变「远光」，既刺眼又: 💡 When retrofitting headlights you must check beam pattern and glare too: swapping bulbs without re-aiming often turns low beam into "high beam", dazzling others and failing inspection.
map.改装或检查车灯时按光源光强与距离估算照度，判断夜间照明是否满足。: When retrofitting or checking lamps, estimate illuminance from source intensity and distance to judge whether night lighting is adequate.
map.验车或维修后核对近光灯地面照度是否达标，避免散光或亮度不足。: After inspection or repair, check that low-beam ground illuminance meets the requirement, avoiding stray light or insufficient brightness.
map.对比 LED 与卤素灯的光强参数，评估实际路照效果。: Compare LED and halogen intensity figures to judge real road illumination.
map.卤素近光灯中心照度演算: Center illuminance of a halogen low beam
map.1500 lm、55 W 的卤素近光，光束半角 15°、灯具效率 85%、非对称: A halogen low beam of 1500 lm and 55 W with a 15° beam half-angle, 85% lamp efficiency and a 0.75 asymmetrical pattern factor gives beam solid angle Ω = 2π(1 − cos15°) ≈ 0.2141 sr and center intensity I = 1500 ÷ 0.2141 × 0.85 × 0.75 ≈ 4467 cd. By the inverse-square law E = I ÷ d², center illuminance at 10 m is about 44.7 lx, above the 20 lx low-beam reference floor; doubling the distance to 20 m drops it to about 11.2 lx. Convert measurements back to the 10 m basis before comparing with the reference floor.
map.为什么车灯照度随距离下降这么快？: Why does headlight illuminance fall away so fast with distance?
map.点光源照度遵循平方反比定律，距离加倍照度降为 1/4。远光照度天然偏低，远光靠提: Point sources obey the inverse-square law, so doubling distance cuts illuminance to a quarter. High beam is naturally dim for this reason and compensated with higher intensity, though road reflection and fog still take their toll.
map.lux 和流明什么区别？: What is the difference between lux and lumens?
map.流明（lm）是光源总光通量，lux 是单位面积接收的照度（lm/m²）。同一光源: Lumens (lm) measure a source's total luminous flux, while lux is the illuminance received per unit area (lm/m²). Move a source farther away and lux falls, but lumens stay the same.
map.按中心照度快速参考判定，正式结论须以 GB 4599 等标准测试点与检测机构报告: Judged quickly from center illuminance; the official verdict follows the test points of GB 4599 and similar standards plus a test-house report
